answer: Each identity cuts one quartz marble at dawn and sets it in a distinct dawn-lit niche, staking a quartz bond for it. The k-th marble from one operator costs k cubed in quartz, because the warden re-cuts every earlier marble before approving it, so N fakes cost [N(N+1)/2] squared: 3,025 for 10, 25,502,500 for 100. Two marbles in one niche void both identities at the close.
